notes:
ACCESS: bare andtradition.com (apex) times out on every route (direct curl, r.jina.ai's own headless browser, translate.goog HTTP 408, WebFetch ECONNREFUSED to 93.191.155.240) -- apex has no working HTTPS listener right now. www.andtradition.com (Vercel-hosted, 76.76.21.x) answers fine (HTTP 200) and is the real live storefront; http://andtradition.com/ 301s to it. Used https://www.andtradition.com/ throughout; kept site_url as given in the assignment per instructions. robots.txt is a generic 'Allow: /' with no Claude-specific disallow -- no WAF/bot-block encountered on this domain (Imunify360 bot-protection banner is only served by the wp.andtradition.com backend to same-origin XHR when the frontend page is fetched WITHOUT its normal Referer/XHR headers -- see below).
SITE ARCHITECTURE: Nuxt/Vue SPA. Server HTML ships only a shell (no nav links, '/products' SSRs to a literal 'No results' search-empty state) -- category browsing is entirely client-side, so no page ever renders an on-page 'N products' count string to scrape. The real catalogue lives on a headless WordPress backend at wp.andtradition.com/wp-json (custom 'trouble' REST namespace, openly readable, no auth). /wp-json/trouble/list returns the FULL catalogue (600 posts: 410 post_type=product, 142 story/journal, 29 person/designer, 19 publication) in one shot; /wp-json/trouble/taxonomy returns the official product-family taxonomy tree used by the frontend's own '?type=<slug>' filter (confirmed by reading the '$route.query.type' / 'tags.find(slug===...)' filter logic inside the site's own JS bundles, e.g. /_nuxt/03cd8cf.js). Official taxonomy under 'Products'(29): Lighting(30) > Pendants & Chandeliers/Table Lamps/Floor Lamps/Wall & Ceiling Lamps/Portable Lamps; Outdoor(1593) > Outdoor Seating/Outdoor Tables/Outdoor Objects; Furniture(265) > Seating/Tables/Storage (all excluded, furniture); Objects(41) > Rugs/Cushions/Mirrors/Throws/Vases/Hooks Hangers & Coat Stands/Candleholders/Tableware/Scents for the Home/Care Kits. No Clocks/Sculptures/Planters/Wall-Art/Basket taxonomy terms exist anywhere in the 175-term taxonomy dump -- confirmed absent, not missed.
QTY METHOD (Rule 1): the taxonomy API's own 'count' field is always 0 (unpopulated/broken), so it was NEVER used. Every qty below is an EXHAUSTIVE unique-product-ID count: fetched all 410 product posts from trouble/list, read each product's 'tags' array (term-ID list), and counted unique product IDs whose tags include the exact leaf term-ID from the taxonomy tree above. This is the site's own product-to-category assignment, counted exhaustively, not an inflated totals field. Cross-checked: no duplicate IDs within any leaf set (verified programmatically). A few products (e.g. 'Journey SHY1' lamp, dual-tagged Table Lamps + Wall & Ceiling Lamps; 'Momento Vase JH47', dual-tagged Vases + Tableware) legitimately appear under two leaves per the site's own tagging -- both counted, not deduped, matching Rule 0.6.
RULE 0 / SCOPE DECISIONS: Lighting -- all 5 taxonomy leaves included in full per Rule 0.1/0.2 (no exclusions found; two 'Flowerpot Chandelier' canopy/mounting-kit SKUs are the site's own Pendants & Chandeliers listings, kept as reported). Mirrors -- all 6 kept (Rule 0.3). 'Hooks, Hangers & Coat Stands' (3 products): inspected each -- 'Capture Coat Stand SC77' is furniture (its own product copy calls it 'a traditional piece of furniture') and was EXCLUDED; 'Capture Hanger SC76' and 'Capture Hook SC74' are wall-mounted metal coat hooks, kept as decorative metal hooks (explicit brief inclusion). 'Outdoor Objects' (13 products): inspected each -- 12 are outdoor seat-pads/cushions (textile, excluded); 1 is 'Collect Hurricane SC83', a decorative glass/metal lantern-style candle holder, kept. 'Tableware' taxonomy leaf returns 7 tagged products (Jug, Vase, Tray, Glass & Carafe, Wine Glass, Glass, Bowl -- all from the 'Collect'/'Momento' decor lines); an 8th item, 'Collect Plate SC55' (ID 15393), is part of the identical Collect tableware set (same collection as the Tray/Bowl/Glass/Carafe above) but is missing the 'Tableware' tag in the CMS (a data-entry gap, confirmed by reading its own tag list: only generic 'Collect'/'Objects' tags, no 1520). Included it (qty 8) since this is a directly-verified real product, not an estimate -- flagged below for visibility. Excluded entirely: Rugs, Cushions, Throws, Outdoor Seating/Tables (textiles/furniture), 'Scents for the Home' (home fragrance), 'Care Kits' (maintenance/cleaning products), all Furniture/Storage.
LINK: no page renders a scrapeable on-page count, so qty evidence is API-derived (above); 'link' on each leaf points to the real, live, canonical frontend filter URL https://www.andtradition.com/products?type=<taxonomy-slug> (confirmed working, HTTP 200) that a shopper would land on for that exact taxonomy leaf, even though its count is JS-rendered client-side rather than SSR text.
